contact_rule: canonical protein heavy atoms strictly less than 4.0 A from modeled native ligand heavy atoms
reference_limitations: The paper calls glycan density poorly defined and models ring-shaped beta-galactose; Methods report dosing N-acetylgalactosamine whereas the deposited component is GAL. The article associates 7MTZ with 2.7 A while current deposition reports 2.43 A. No deposited local ligand fit metrics in the archived validation, and all 60 GAL copies carry a torsion flag. This is not an independently certified atomic pose.
